verdict.rationale: A sandbox test environment is a fair question for a compliance and registered-agent services platform that could expose APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into it. No product content was retrieved, so there is no evidence of any sandbox or test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
